Package com.vector.cfg.dom.modemgt.groovy.bswm

The ModeMgm bswm package contains the BswM-related interfaces of the mode management domain API.

See: Description

  • Interface Summary 
    Interface Description
    IBswMAutoConfigurationApi
    IBswMAutoConfigurationApi allows for automatic creation of dedicated parts of the BswM configuration.
    IBswMAutoConfigurationDomain
    IBswMAutoConfigurationDomain provides read-access to a BswM auto configuration domain.
    IBswMAutoConfigurationElement
    IBswMAutoConfigurationElement provides read-access to common properties of BswM auto configuration elements (IBswMAutoConfigurationFeature, IBswMAutoConfigurationParameter, IBswMAutoConfigurationDomain).
    IBswMAutoConfigurationFeature
    IBswMAutoConfigurationFeature provides read-access to a BswM auto configuration feature.
    IBswMAutoConfigurationOverride
    IBswMAutoConfigurationOverride is for deciding on what is to become of previously applied manual adaptations to the BswM auto configuration content on subsequent auto confugration runs.
    IBswMAutoConfigurationParameter
    IBswMAutoConfigurationFeature provides read-access to a BswM auto configuration parameter.
    IBswMAutoConfigurationParameterSetter
    Interface for assigning a value to an BswM auto configuration parameter.
  • Exception Summary 
    Exception Description
    BswMAutoConfigException
    BswMAutoConfigException is thrown by the IBswMAutoConfigurationApi when auto configuration fails.

Package com.vector.cfg.dom.modemgt.groovy.bswm Description
